ACCESS MODE
CREDENTIAL POLLING
WHAT ASTRANULL READS
Zone list, then the rulesets attached to each zone.
MINIMUM PERMISSION
Zone > Zone > Read. Add Zone > WAF > Read to include rulesets.
CREDENTIAL FORMAT
The token string, or {"api_token":"..."}
Steps
In the Cloudflare dashboard open My Profile > API Tokens and select Create Token.
Choose Create custom token and give it a recognizable name.
Add the permission Zone > Zone > Read, and optionally Zone > WAF > Read.
Under Zone Resources, limit the token to the zones you want validated.
Select Continue to summary, then Create Token, and paste the token here once.
Never performed

Never edits DNS records, rules, or zone settings.

Troubleshooting

If the poll reports a rulesets permission gap, the token lacks Zone > WAF > Read. Zones still import; rulesets are skipped.

Create a Slack incoming webhook
Open api.slack.com/apps, choose Create New App, then From scratch, and pick your workspace.
Under Features, open Incoming Webhooks and switch Activate Incoming Webhooks on.
Select Add New Webhook to Workspace, choose the channel that should receive alerts, and select Authorize.
Copy the webhook URL. It looks like https://hooks.slack.com/services/T…/B…/…. Paste it below.

Treat the URL like a password. Slack revokes webhook URLs it finds published online.

Create a Teams Workflows webhook
In Microsoft Teams, go to the channel that should receive alerts, select More options (…), then Workflows.
Search for the template Send webhook alerts to a channel and select it.
Confirm the team and channel, then select Save.
Copy the webhook URL shown once the workflow is created. Paste it below.

Microsoft 365 (Office 365) connectors are being retired, so use Workflows rather than the legacy Incoming Webhook connector. A workflow belongs to the person who created it; add a co-owner so alerts keep flowing if that person leaves. Teams messages are limited to 28 KB, and larger cards are refused before sending. The card includes a View in AstraNull button when your operator sets ASTRANULL_PORTAL_URL.
